cards.caption: A New York judge upheld the city's rent freeze, a ruling that keeps rents in place and is a win for Mamdani's affordability agenda. The decision was reported by Gothamist.

A Swiss tourist was killed and several British and American visitors were injured by elephants in a remote Cameroon national park, according to reports trending in US searches. Details remain limited in the headlines available.
The UK has asked 100,000 reservists to stand by in case of war with Russia, while Jared Kushner says Putin has shown restraint.
The NBA Cup group stage wraps up on its final day, and the standings will determine who moves on to the knockout bracket.
UNITED24 Media reports that Russia has spent $226 billion on weapons for its war in Ukraine, counting tanks that were never destroyed.
Sequent, a formal verification startup, has raised $2.2 million in a pre-seed round co-led by Metaplanet and Frachtis. The company works on proving that code obeys its safety rules.
More than 1,000 flights in the US were cancelled or delayed as a storm disrupted Thanksgiving travel. Weather is still affecting travel plans across the country.

Ukrainian intelligence says North Korea has halted military aid to Russia because of a diplomatic dispute. The Kyiv Post reports the claim, which has not been independently confirmed in the headlines we reviewed.
Gigi Paris, who dated Glen Powell before their split, is now engaged to former NFL player Cooper Helfet. The news is drawing a lot of searches this week.
IonQ's shares lost 25% of their value over one month, and one Wall Street analyst still sees near 200% gains ahead. Analyst forecasts are opinions, not guarantees.
Reuters reports that Israeli strikes in Gaza killed 10 people and that Hamas is weighing its response. Other reports in the same news cycle cover strikes in Lebanon.
A surprise 10% tariff on jets threatens to squeeze American airlines, according to The Independent. The move lands as travelers prepare for a busy holiday travel period.
Lute has raised $20M to build touch-based AI for robots. The round was reported by The Recursive.
Carson Schwesinger is being tipped as the Browns' midseason MVP as the team heads into its bye week. Three options are in the running for the team's top honour.
Italy has warned that the war in Ukraine must not spread into the Mediterranean after a strike on Russian ships off Libya. The Libyan army says two of its officers were killed in the attack.
Investors are accusing Medline of hiding quality failures after its $7.2B IPO. The claims raise questions about what the company disclosed before listing.
A Thanksgiving gathering at a rented house in Polk County ended in a shooting that the sheriff says left one person dead and six injured. The sheriff's office has provided the figures so far.
Italy says an Iranian drone strike in Kuwait killed two workers for Rheinmetall, while Iran denies responsibility and offers a joint probe. The competing claims remain unresolved.
Six-time MotoGP champion Marc Marquez has announced he will retire after the 2026 season. The news is drawing strong interest from American fans searching for the latest on the rider.
AI data-center developer LIAN is picking London for a $500 million IPO. The listing shows how AI infrastructure companies are looking to public markets for funding.
A Thanksgiving Day storm knocked out power for half a million people on the East Coast, according to reports. Crews are working through wind and rain-damaged areas.
The Green Bay Packers have issued a statement after Lions owner and chair emeritus Martha Firestone Ford died at 101. The report is based on the headline and statement only.

The Israeli military says it killed four Hamas operatives in Gaza, including one involved in the October 7 attack and a hostage handover. The claim comes from the IDF and has not been independently confirmed in these reports.
A semi carrying mail jackknifed on I-75N near downtown Toledo, blocking overpasses until crews cleared it. Traffic is moving again.
Hamas says Israel attempted to assassinate the son of its leader in Gaza, according to a report from A News. The claim has not been independently confirmed in the headlines we reviewed.
Maple AI has raised $5.3M to expand its private AI platform. The round is aimed at growing that product.
A lottery winner was arrested by ICE days after claiming a $1 million prize, according to NBC News. The report raises questions about how the case unfolded.
Secretary of State Marco Rubio says the US struck Iran out of fear it would retaliate for an Israeli attack, according to ABC News. The headline gives no casualty or damage figures.
Brock Purdy has been ruled out for the 49ers' game against the Seahawks with an ankle injury, and Mac Jones will start at quarterback. Purdy missed a second straight practice before the decision.
Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacifico has completed the FIBRA GAP IPO at Ps. 7.82 billion. The listing gives investors a stake in the trust behind the Pacific airport group.
The Pentagon has identified all six American troops killed in Kuwait amid the Iran war. Their names are now public.
Texas has ended its moratorium on data centers, a move that opens the state to more AI infrastructure. The change is likely to be watched closely across the country.
Dunzo founder Kabeer Biswas' AI startup M has raised $9 million in a follow-on round led by RTP. The company is building AI aimed at automating the home.
WWE star Bronson Reed has died at 38, according to CNN, which cited medical complications. Fans and wrestlers are reacting to the loss.
Ukraine has put forward a Black Sea ceasefire proposal aimed at protecting grain exports. It is waiting for Russia's reply.
Stocks rebounded hard after a $6 trillion washout, with Nvidia, Micron and SpaceX leading a $3.5 trillion surge. The S&P 500 had its best week in 19 months as AI stocks bounced back.
The Supreme Court has agreed to hear a major Second Amendment case on AR-15 bans. The outcome could shape gun laws nationwide.
Doctors Without Borders says an Israeli strike killed two of its staff outside a Gaza clinic, and the Israeli military says both men were Hamas operatives.
Nicole Scherzinger and fiancé Thom Evans have split after a 3-year engagement, and Evans has shared a heartbreaking statement. The news has trended as fans search for details.
